summary: The upgrade error "can't parse timestamptz with DateStyle 'Redwood, SHOW_TIME'" means the external database has an unexpected DateStyle; comment it out in postgres.conf, set datestyle = 'iso, mdy' and systemctl reload postgresql.
questions: NotImplementedError: can't parse timestamptz with DateStyle 'Redwood, SHOW_TIME'
How do I fix the DateStyle error when upgrading the AAP Operator?
What datestyle does AAP need on an external PostgreSQL?

answer_card.title: Fix the DateStyle upgrade error
answer_card.answer_md:
On the database server, in `/var/lib/pgsql/data/postgres.conf`:
```
#datestyle = 'Redwood, SHOW_TIME'
datestyle = 'iso, mdy'
```
Then `systemctl reload postgresql` (does not disrupt the database).
